newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Floods halt Pasminco mine shipments.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Floods halt Pasminco mine shipments.

text.p: Pasminco Ltd said on Tuesday that rail shipments of lead and zinc mine concentrates from its Broken Hill mine in New South Wales to the Port Pirie smelter in South Australia have been halted due to flooding.
The smelter was still able to operate by drawing on stocks of concentrates on hand, a Pasminco spokeswoman told Reuters.
"Both Broken Hill and Port Pirie are still operating," the spokeswoman said.
Broken Hill ships about 11,000 tonnes of concentrates to Port Pirie each week, she said.

The spokeswoman declined to say how much stock was available at Port Pirie, but said the company planned to make a public statement on the situation later on Tuesday following a meeting between Pasminco and the National Rail Corp.
About 37 km of railway line was washed away in the last three or four days due to the flooding, the spokeswoman said.
Pasminco was investigating alternative rail shipment routes and the possiblity of shipping concentrates by truck until repairs to the raline line are completed, she said.
The Port Pirie smelter produces about 200,000 tonnes of lead and 38,000 tonnes of zinc annually.
